title: New Residential Construction (Building Permits, Housing Starts, Completions — November 2026 data) — 8:30 a.m. ET, six days past the funding cliff
source: CENSUS: two independent census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research, plus two non-Census corroborations. (1) economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 179 table rows parsed), row "New Residential Construction (Building Permits, Housing Starts, and Housing Completions) | December 17, 2026 | 8:30 AM | November 2026", release code A202612170830, reference A202611 — and the same page's only four `Suspended` rows are Steel Imports and the Advance Economic Indicators Report, not this series. (2) construction/soc/schedule.html, the Survey of Construction Release Schedule (HTTP 200, 59,625 bytes), whose terminal row reads "November 2026 | December 17, 2026 | December 23, 2026" under the column heads "(12th Workday) New Residential Construction - 8:30 a.m." and "(17th Workday) Revised Building Permits - 8:00 a.m. / New Residential Sales - 10:00 a.m.". (3) Census's own construction/xls/historic_release_dates.xls (HTTP 200, 55,808 bytes, 515 rows 1984-01 → 2026-11), terminal row: reference 2026-11 → NRC 2026-12-17, NRS 2026-12-23. (4) The Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-12-17 08:30 row reads "Housing starts, Import and export prices". Promoted `estimate` → `confirmed` and `EST:` → `CENSUS:` on the two-primary precedent this calendar already carries for durable-goods-2026-11-25 and m3-full-report-2026-12-03. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: Canonical file written by this id's own initial research (2026-09-06) after reading both proposals — `from-existing-home-sales-2026-12-09` and `from-mtis-2026-12-16` — which are now shadowed. Three findings correct or sharpen what those proposals assumed. (1) WIRING CORRECTION: `SplicedNewHousingConstruction` is NOT this print. It is the ticker on GDPNow's Residential!E9, whose own label column reads `"Real" private new housing construction (VPIP)` — value of construction put in place, i.e. Census's CONSTRUCTION SPENDING release (construction-spending-2026-12-01); its nonresidential twin at NonresStructures!F9 reads `"Real" private nonresidential construction put-in-place (C30)`, the same release. Two sibling ledgers attribute that ticker to this print on a ticker-name read. Housing starts instead enters GDPNow through the ACTIVITY FACTOR: `FactorAugARCoeffs` carries nine series from this one release (HST, HPT permits, HSTW/HSTS/HSTMW/HSTNE, HST1, HSTM, and the derived NomSingleStarts). (2) The proposals' CONCLUSION nevertheless survives and is stronger than they claimed: across the 1,822 same-quarter deltas in `ContribArchives`, the 143 housing-starts vintages move the residential contribution a median 0.0609pp against 0.0058pp for the other 1,679 (p<0.0001) — 1.62x the existing-home leaf's 0.0376pp, which this session reproduced exactly as a cross-check — and on the 100 SOLO starts vintages residential is the largest component move 96.0% of the time against a 20.7% base rate. (3) The homebuilder question the first proposal left open is answered WITH A DATE: on 515 real release dates from Census's own file, ITB's overnight gap (the metric that isolates an 08:30 print) beat baseline in 2006-09 (1.104% vs 0.766%, p=0.032) and 2010-15 (0.615% vs 0.400%, p=0.0017) and has been null since — 2016-20 p=0.50, 2021-26 p=0.46. Impact LOW and symbols empty: no house playbook is macro- or housing-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, 0 hits) and the sector edge is eleven years dead. The cliff exposure is real and this series' response is its own: 9 of 514 releases since 1984 slipped out of the month after their reference month and all 9 belong to a federal funding lapse; unlike the Advance Economic Indicators Report, which Census marks `Suspended` and deletes, this series DEFERS AND MERGES — Sep+Oct 2025 both published 2026-01-09 after 114 dark days, Nov+Dec 2025 on 2026-02-18, Feb+Mar 2026 on 2026-04-29, normal cadence not restored until 2026-05-21. Date `confirmed`; nothing here licenses an entry.
